sources.title: t-timms/bible-ai-assistant: Bible Q&A - GitHub
sources.snippet: Most Bible apps offer keyword search. This project builds a real AI that understands Scripture — fine-tuned on theology, grounded in retrieved passages, and guardrailed against hallucination. It combines a custom ORPO-trained Qwen3.5-4B model with hybrid RAG (BM25 + dense retrieval + cross-encoder reranking) and constitutional AI safety checks.
